guides.definition: Uses a reusable Jackson ObjectMapper to create formatted JSON text. Project dependency only: add Jackson Databind to a Maven or Gradle project; the isolated Java runner does not resolve external dependencies.

examples.title: Serialize a record
examples.explanation: ObjectMapper instances are thread-safe after configuration and are normally reused rather than constructed for every operation.

guides.definition: Reads JSON text into the selected Java type with ObjectMapper. Project dependency only: add Jackson Databind to a Maven or Gradle project; the isolated Java runner does not resolve external dependencies.

parameters.name: typeName
parameters.description: Class or record used for deserialization.

examples.title: Deserialize a user
examples.code:
ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();
User value = mapper.readValue(jsonText, User.class);
examples.explanation: The target class or record defines property names and conversion rules; configure unknown-property handling deliberately for external inputs.

guides.definition: Parses JSON into JsonNode and reads a nested value without defining a model type. Project dependency only: add Jackson Databind to a Maven or Gradle project; the isolated Java runner does not resolve external dependencies.

parameters.name: fallback
parameters.description: Value used when the node has no text value.

examples.title: Read an optional status
examples.explanation: path returns a missing node instead of null for an absent field; asText supplies an explicit fallback.
